verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform like Vanta, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Vanta publishing its platform source under an open license. The official Auditor API SDKs and the hosted MCP server are developer building blocks and integrations, not the product's own source under an open license, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
